name: Golden Eclipse

effects.description: Passive: Overwhelm stacks store more damage.
Active: Mel unleashes a radiant blast on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing magic damage to each of them. Enemies are also revealed for 1 second from the start of the cast time.

modifiers.tooltip:
Scaling per rank:
4 / 7 / 10 (+ 4% AP) per Overwhelm stack on the target
modifiers.unit: (+ 4% AP) per Overwhelm stack on the target

effects.description: An enemy champion affected by Overwhelm is required to cast this ability.

notes:
Golden Eclipse can be cast even if all affected targets are  untargetable.(unexpected)
Golden Eclipse does not deal damage against enemies that are  untargetable.
Whenever Golden Eclipse's damage would put a target below  Overwhelm's threshold, it will use a  different icon.
Golden Eclipse will display the number of total stacks affecting all enemy champions in the HUD.
Golden Eclipse sets the duration of  Overwhelm stacks to 0.75 seconds if they would run out during the cast time.
